phrase.text: The engine warns with diagnostics: errors prevent running, warnings do not, and failures happen while the program runs.

runs.text: The engine warns with diagnostics: errors prevent running, warnings do not, and failures happen while the program runs.
Every notice from the engine is a

. They all have the same shape: a stable code, a severity, the exact position in the text and a message in the interface language. The code does not change with the language; that is why you can look it up in the catalogue.

runs.text: If lexical or syntax analysis finds an error, the semantic checks do not run on the broken tree. That way a single slip does not multiply into dozens of messages that explain nothing.

points.text: A diagnostic has a code, a severity, a position and a translated message.
Classes: lexical, syntax, semantic and runtime.
Errors prevent running; warnings do not.
Runtime failures depend on concrete values.
